name: CRL-40-940
summary: Bisfluoro analogue Modafinil. Sold sometimes online as a research chemical. The drug was patented in 2013. It is slightly more potent than Armodafinil.

pharmacology.text: Flmodafinil is a selective dopamine reuptake inhibitor (DRI). Its affinity (Ki) for the DAT is 4,090 nM.

uses.text: Flmodafinil (developmental code names CRL-40,940, NLS-4, JBG01-41), also known as bisfluoromodafinil and lauflumide, is a wakefulness-promoting agent related to modafinil which has been developed for treatment of a variety of different medical conditions. Aside from its development as a potential pharmaceutical drug, flmodafinil is sold online and used non-medically as a nootropic (cognitive enhancer).

sideEffects.en: It has been little studied in people. Its close relative modafinil can cause headache, sleeplessness, anxiety, nausea and a faster heartbeat, and rarely serious skin reactions.
sideEffects.zh: 它幾乎沒有在人體中研究過。它的近親莫達非尼可能造成頭痛、失眠、焦慮、噁心與心跳加快，少數情況下會引發嚴重的皮膚反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它几乎没有在人体中研究过。它的近亲莫达非尼可能造成头痛、失眠、焦虑、恶心与心跳加快，少数情况下会引发严重的皮肤反应。

fact.en: The CRL in its code name marks it as a compound from the French company Laboratoires Lafon, which discovered adrafinil and modafinil. It is modafinil with a fluorine atom added to each of its two benzene rings.
fact.zh: 代號中的 CRL 表示它是法國拉豐實驗室的化合物，這家公司也發現了阿屈非尼與莫達非尼。它是在莫達非尼的兩個苯環上各加了一個氟原子。
fact.zhHans: 代号中的 CRL 表示它是法国拉丰实验室的化合物，这家公司也发现了阿屈非尼与莫达非尼。它是在莫达非尼的两个苯环上各加了一个氟原子。
